questions.question: For internal financing of Five Year Plans, the Government depends on ________.

options.text: Taxation, public borrowing and deficit financing

questions.solution:
__
 
• **For sustaining Five-Year Plans, internal financing is done through taxation, public borrowing and deficit financing.**__
 
• Public borrowing through the issue of government bonds, funds accumulated through small saving schemes, direct and indirect taxation, and deficit financing are the viable options for internal financing.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is taxation, public borrowing and deficit financing.

questions.question: What is the relative molecular mass of water?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__18 u__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The relative molecular mass of water (H2O) is 18.
 
• The relative molecular mass is unitless. 
 
• How to find relative molecular mass?​

 
• Determine the chemical formula of the molecule.
 
• Use the Periodic Table to determine the atomic mass of each element.
 
• Multiply the atomic mass by the number of atoms of each element in the molecule.
 
• Add the values to get the relative molecular mass.

 
• The relative molecular mass of water:-

 
 
• The formula for water is H2O. Each molecule contains 2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom.
 
• Relative atomic masses: (H (Hydrogen) = 1, O (Oxygen) = 16).
 
• Thus, The relative molecular mass of water is - 
 
• M_r (H₂O)= {2*A_r(H) + A_r(O)} = 2 x 1 + 16 = **18**

questions.question: What is the pH value of human blood?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7.4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pH values range from 0 to 14.
 
• A pH less than 7 is acidic and greater than 7 is basic.
 
• The pH value of human blood is 7.4.
 
• pH value of human blood is 7.4
 
• It is basic in nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• pH value is used to indicate the acidity or basicity of an aqueous solution.
 
• A pH of 7 is considered neutral.
 
• The pH of acids is lower than 7.
 
• The pH of bases is more than 7.
 
• So, human blood can be said to be slightly basic in nature.
 
• the pH scale is from 0 to 14 where 0 means most acidic and 14 means most basic.
 
• It is a logarithmic scale and not a linear scale.

questions.question: Which is NOT an example of organism that breaks down the food material outside the body and then absorb it?
questions.solution:
• Those organisms that break down the organic food material outside their body by the secretions of hydrolytic enzymes are called decomposers.
 
• These decompose the complex organic food into the simpler inorganic substances and then absorb them.
 
• Bread mould, Yeast, Mushrooms are Fungi. These are decomposers.
 
• Snake take holozoic nutrition in which the food is digested in the body.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Snake.

questions.question: Each trait in the child can be influenced by ______ DNA.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**both paternal and maternal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A child develops from a **zygote.**
 
• A zygote is formed by the **fusion of a male gamete (sperm) and a female gamete (ovum)** in the process of **fertilization.**
 
• The genetic material contained in the male and female gametes is responsible for influencing the trait of the child.
 
• So,** both paternal and maternal DNA** influence the traits in a child.** Hence, the correct answer is ‘Both paternal and maternal’.**

questions.question: On 19 September 2017, Law Ministry approved Fugitive Economic Offenders Bill, 2017. The Bill entrusts the responsibility to try cases of Fugitive Economic Offenders under ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fugitive Economic Offenders Bill, 2017 entrusts the responsibility to try cases of Fugitive Economic Offenders under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA).
 
• It will not allow the offenders to evade the process of Indian law by fleeing the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__****Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA)**

 
• Money laundering is the process of bringing illegal money into an economy by hiding its illegal origin so that it appears to be legally acquired.
 
• The Government of India launched the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) in 2002 to rein in money-laundering activities. 
 
 
• ​It is a criminal law of the Parliament of India passed in 2002 to prevent money laundering and confiscate property derived from the laundered money.
 
• It came into force on **July 1, 2005.**
 
 

Some of the core objectives of the Act-

 
• Prevention and controlling money laundering.
 
• Confiscation and seizing of property involved in or derived from money laundering.
 
• Providing punishment to offenders
 
• Appointment of adjudicating authority and appellate tribunal concerning money laundering matters
 
• Maintaining records and putting obligations on financial institutions, banking companies, and institutions
 
• Dealing with every issue related to money laundering

questions.question: A __________ is known by different names in different parts of the world. It is called a ‘hurricane’ in North America.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**cyclone**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cyclone is known by different names in different parts of the world.
 
• It is called a ‘hurricane’ in North America.
 
• It is a large-scale air mass with a low-pressure area.
 
• They are called "typhoons is called in the western North Pacific and Philippines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Hurricanes are large, swirling storms that form over warm ocean waters.

Parts of the Hurricane are as follows-

 
• **Eye**- it is the hole at the center of the storm and the winds are light in this area.
 
• **Eye Wall-**The eyewall is a ring of the storm and the storm swirl around the eye.
 
• **Rain Bands-**These is clouds and rain that go far out from a hurricane's eyewall.
 
• A hurricane starts out as a tropical disturbance.
 
• A tropical storm becomes a hurricane if its winds reach 119 km/hr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Typhoons and hurricanes are the same types of storms. According to geographical position, the name of this storm varies.
 
• In the western Pacific Ocean, these storms are called **Typhoons** whereas in the Eastern Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, and the Gulf of Mexico they are called **Hurricanes**.
 
• In Australia, the Bay of Bengal, and the Indian Ocean these types of storms are called **cyclones**.
